facts.fact: Kyle 清晨来帮忙装车；昨夜 Zak 在 Zara 家带娃（Ollie 刷牙犯傻气、Jade 姐姐训服）；被问「你们俩还好吗」他答 No——「The Zara is strong in that one」。
facts.anchor: “Ollie got a case of the sillies when it was time to brush teeth, but Jade read him the riot act.

facts.fact: Zak 向妹夫自责回家太迟；已短信 Erica 谈公寓归属与书面安排、宣布不回温哥华——她尚未回复；Meg 从后门探头（蓝衫黑bra影、牛仔裤）夸他首单。
facts.anchor: “I should have come home sooner to help with Dad,” I said once we’d set down the tabletop inside the van.

facts.fact: Meg 用 paint can 当门挡出来调侃；单是 Dale 卖的：Leavenworth（西雅图东、60年代巴伐利亚主题镇）夫妇翻新 Airbnb 老宅——免费送货捎带 sideboard+china cabinet+红木床架，换一晚住宿。
facts.anchor: Did you actually make a sale, Zak?” She feigned astonishment.

facts.fact: 迪士尼次年父母带他们去 Leavenworth「当欧洲玩」——Zara 的巴黎执念由此而来；Zak 仍记仇（I’m still mad）；此行要带 Dale 去胡桃夹子博物馆（What could go wrong? 的 deadpan）。
facts.anchor: “Mom and Dad took us there the year after they took us to Disneyland.

facts.fact: Kyle 点破「你和她…？」——朋友是真的、也是白色谎言（至少他那侧）；Kyle 逼问「你跟 Erica 说你不回去了」——Zak 用烧水壶反问堵回他的婚姻话题，Thelma（货车名）送上路。
facts.anchor: “We’re friends.” It was true. But also a white lie, on my side at least.
